description: Credential lifecycle ownership in Zen Mesh. Each credential type has its own lifecycle owner. ZenLock provides custody/distribution/audit, not rotation.

credential_types.zenlock_role: Stores/distributes HMAC key material. Does NOT perform rotation.

credential_types.custody_distribution: ZenLock distributes cert material where applicable
credential_types.verification: TLS handshake (server + client cert for mTLS)
credential_types.zenlock_role: Distributes cert material where applicable. Does NOT perform cert rotation.

credential_types.custody_distribution: ZenLock stores signing key material where applicable
credential_types.zenlock_role: Custody of signing key material. Does NOT perform JWK rotation.

credential_types.rotation_owner: cert-manager renewal; future: SPIRE Workload API
credential_types.verification: SaaS/back mTLS peer cert verification with SPIFFE ID extraction
credential_types.zenlock_role: No SVID ownership. ZenLock does NOT own SVID lifecycle.

zenlock_summary.role: Encrypted secret custody, controlled distribution, and audit support
zenlock_summary.not_role: Universal rotation engine, credential lifecycle owner, SVID lifecycle owner
zenlock_summary.correct_wording: ZenLock provides encrypted custody, controlled distribution, and audit support. Rotation workflows use ZenLock to protect and distribute new secret material.
forbidden_wording: ZenLock handles canary deployment and automatic rollback
